name: letagents-desktop
description: A desktop control plane for collaborating AI agents.

scripts.build:dev: npm run build:mcp && npm run build:electron && npm run build:daemon
scripts.serve:electron: wait-on tcp:5174 ../../dist/mcp/server.js dist-electron/main.js dist-daemon/main.js && cross-env LETAGENTS_DESKTOP_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5174 electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && npm run build:daemon
scripts.smoke:electron: npm run build && cross-env LETAGENTS_DESKTOP_SMOKE_CHECK=1 electron .
scripts.screenshot:agent-detail: npm run build && cross-env LETAGENTS_DESKTOP_SMOKE_CHECK=1 LETAGENTS_DESKTOP_AGENT_DETAIL_SCREENSHOT=/tmp/letagents-agent-detail-responsive.png electron .
scripts.screenshot:board: npm run build && cross-env LETAGENTS_DESKTOP_SMOKE_CHECK=1 LETAGENTS_DESKTOP_BOARD_SCREENSHOT=/tmp/letagents-room-board.png electron .
scripts.screenshot:board-tasks: npm run build && cross-env LETAGENTS_DESKTOP_SMOKE_CHECK=1 LETAGENTS_DESKTOP_BOARD_FIXTURE=tasks LETAGENTS_DESKTOP_BOARD_SCREENSHOT=/tmp/letagents-room-board-tasks.png electron .
scripts.screenshot:updates: npm run build && cross-env LETAGENTS_DESKTOP_SMOKE_CHECK=1 LETAGENTS_DESKTOP_UPDATES_SCREENSHOT=/tmp/letagents-desktop-updates.png electron .
scripts.test: npm run test:renderer && npm run test:electron && npm run test:daemon && npm run test:packaging
